title: UMS process preview response
description: Written by ProcessPreviewAdapter (crates/ums-profile-sdk/src/preview.rs) only after the runner ran twice as separate processes, each writing its documents to its own files in a private directory, every document pair was byte-identical, and the validator exited 0. A refused or failed preview produces no response document. Numbers are integers within +-(2^53-1). Version 2 (2026-11-14, package B2) replaced the version-1 stdout stream of documents with one file per document.

replay.description: Both runner processes wrote identical bytes into each document file. A difference is refused as ReplayMismatch, so no other value exists. Runner stdout is not compared: a runner may print the paths it wrote.

runnerOutput.description: The {runner_output} file: an enaction-runner-output/1 envelope from a real runner. Its full schema belongs to Enaction (CAC-KERNEL section 9).

mindTrace.description: The {mind_trace} file, present only when the runner template named it: an enaction-mind-trace/1 document (CAC-KERNEL section 10).

stdout.description: enaction-validate prints the canonical envelope and a newline, then, with --mind-trace, the canonical mind trace and a newline.
